translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus e Toafi Pirheer Rhooan Kkayeo

Igina nge a eraaen me weni mmwaen miniwe gupwunon Passover. Jesus a giuneei pwe a itto oaton aan epwene nigiti faeinaengiy pwe epwene noa reen miniwe Seman. Iiy e fasiun gin aerhaengiir rhooakka noan faeinaengiy ikka naiun, nge e aerhaengiir toori noa amwiucchiun aan menaw.
Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra mwongoon faaef. Nge Saetan a fasiun iseni nong nee tipaen Judas, mwaaen we naiun Simon Iscariot, pwe epwe fangenoa tinnimaen Jesus.
Jesus e giuneei pwe mwaaen we Seman nge efang ngaeni oanongaen mamaaw; e giuneei pwe iiy e itto me reen Deus nge epwene sefaaen ngaeni Deus.
Iwe a iutae me reen table we, a iseni tiw mengaagiun niugiun, nge a geonitae eew toawun nugunupan.
Iwe a aekkinong rhaan noan eew saepiy nge a rhaepetae aan toafi pirheer rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun, nge e aepaena ngaeni toawun we e geeogeeo nugunupan.
A itto reen Simon Peter, nge Peter a aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, wopwe toafi pirheei?”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Igina wose metefaaegini minne ifeeori, nge faeiyegius noa nge wopwe naaen metaf.”
Peter a iura pwe, “Esooar faaen eew ne wopwe toafi pirheei!” Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Aere igine ise toafi pirhemw nge wosoapw nono pwe een naeyi rhooan kkayeo.”
Simon Peter a aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, ina nge saapw pirheei rhag minne wopwe toafi! Wopwe pwan toafi paeyi me rhimwei!”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Rhooakka ra tiutiu nge a nimegacch noa wooar, nge resoapw tiutiu no pwe pirheer rhag epwe tiutiu. Oanongaemi nge oawwa aenimenim — nge erhai rhag ese aenimenim.” (
Jesus a fasiun giuneei iyo epwene fangenoa tinnimaen; ina faaen miniwe e iura pwe, “Oanongaemi nge oawwa aenimenim — nge erhai rhag ese aenimenim.”)
Weni mwirin aaen Jesus toafi pirheer, a iseni sefaaen tae minikkewe mengaagiun nge a noa mooat sefaaen tiw reen table we. A iura pwe, “Oaw metaf reen miniwe ifeeori ngaenigaemi?
Oaw faingi ngaeniaei pwe Sinsei me Soamwoon, nge efin pwe oawpwe ina wusun ngaeniaei, pwe iga ina minna ngaang.
Ngaang, aaemi Soamwoon me Sinsei, nge iya toafi pirhemi. Iwe nge aaemi oawpwan toafi pirheen erhai me erhai me neeimi.
I aweri ngaenigaemi minneen pwe oawpwe giuneei, pwe oawpwe feeori wunuunun meeta we ifeeori ngaenigaemi.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen: esooar slave ne e taegias saengi aan maasta, nge esooar rhooan pweipwogin kkepas ne e taegias saengi iyo na e akkiuneo.
Iga oawwa giuneei minneei, ifa mwo aaemi kker igine oawpwene noa pomwoni!
“Ngaang ise kkepas reemi oanongaemi; i giuneer iyo kka i finiir. Iwe nge miniwe mwaeniaen Pwapwior we e Santus epwe pwae noa iwe e iura pwe, ‘Mwaaen we e mwongo reei a appaniuwaeniaei.’
Igina i aengaenigaemi minneei weni mmwaen epwe wen, pwe epwe noa wen nge oaw niugiuniug pwe, ‘Ngaang ina ngaang.’
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen: iyo e aetiwa iiy iwe i aefenga e aetiwaeyaei; nge iyo e aetiwaeyaei epwan aetiwa iyo na efangeto ngaang.”
Jesus a Aepesa Wunuunun Aar Aefenganoa Tinnimaen
Weni mwirin aaen Jesus aepesa minneei a igin cchoaw nee tipan iwe a iura pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi minna wenewenen, pwe erhai me neeimi epwene fangenoa tinnimaei.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra wegitaeg fengaen wooar pwe resa metaf reen miniwe e iura.
Erhai me neeiir rhooan kkayeo kkewe, mwaaen we Jesus e igin aerhaengi, iwe emooat oaron Jesus.
Simon Peter a cchimw ngaeni nge a iura pwe, “Aeiineow ngaere iyo mwu e iyaekkepesa?”
Iwe rhooan kkayeo we e aeppwaenaeg ngaeni Jesus nge a aeiineow pwe, “Soamwoon, iyo na?”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ieei ipwene rhirinong fenoawa een nge iya ngaenneei; nge ina manna iiy.” Iwe a rhirinong fenoawa we nge ngaenneei Judas we naiun Simon Iscariot.
Igiwe rhag Judas e pwigi fenoawa we nge Saetan a toonong noan pwunnon. Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Mwetekkaei, wonoa feeori minna wopwe feeori!”
Esooar erhai neeiir rhooawe oaron table we ne e metefaaegini faaen miniwe Jesus e aengaeni.

Iwe nge pwonno igiwe Judas miniwe rhooan pweipwogin tutuun senaapiy, aaemweoi rhooan kkayeo kkewe re niuwaennei pwe Jesus e aengaeni pwe epwe noa a noa chuwaiuw aemwetaen gupwun we, aere ngaenneer rhooa affayeo eew aegiaeg.
Judas e pwigi rhag fenoawa we nge a noa. A nee pwoong miniwe.
Anniug Ffeo we
Mwirin aaen Judas noa nge Jesus a iura pwe, “Igina epwene pwae noa nningen mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas; nge minna nningen Deus ina epwene pwae noa pwe aegin iiy.
Iwe ngaere minna nningen Deus epwaetae me reen, iwe Deus wooan oanongan epwe pwan pwaeritae nningen mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas, nge epwe feeori igina rhag.
Aaemi naeyi, a egius mmwaai rhag nge ipwene nigitigaemi. Oawpwene giuttayaei; iwe nge igina ipwene aengaenigaemi miniwe i aengaeniir soamwoonin Jews, ‘Oawsoapw mmwenen noa iga ipwene noa ee.’
Iwe igina ipwene ngaennegaemi eew anniug ffeo: oaw aerhaengi fengaennigaemi. Taeppen rhag aaei aerhaengigaemi, iwe aaemi oawpwe aerhaengi fengaennigaemi.
Aere igine oaw aerhaengi fengaennigaemi, ina nge oanongeer aeremas repwe giuneei pwe aaemi minikkewe naeyi rhooan kkayeo.”
Jesus e Aepesa Aaen Peter Iura pwe Ese Giuneei
Simon Peter a aeiineow pwe, “Soamwoon, wopwene noa iya?” Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Wosoapw mmwenen tapweaei noa igina ngaang ipwe noa ee, epwe mwirin noa nge oawpwapw tapweto mwiriy.”
Peter a aeiineow pwe, “Soamwoon, meeta isoapw mmwenen tapweog noa iginaan reen? Ngaang iya moannotae pwe ipwe mae noa faaen itoamw!”

Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Wa moannotae pwe wopwe mae noa faaen itaei? Ennetaen, ipwe aengaeniug minna wenewenen, pwe weni mmwaen aan epwe keokkeok maniug nge epwe faaen enuuw oamw iura pwe wose giuneaei.”
